name: code-review
description: Triage a single review finding. It does not write the review — it grades a finding that already exists.

blocksMerge.instructions: Should this finding block the merge?

criteria.true: causes incorrect behaviour, data loss, or a security hole
criteria.false: style, taste, or an improvement that can land later

actionable.instructions: Does the finding name a specific location and a specific change, rather than a general concern?
